description: Jobs conformance (JOB-01): scenarios of @jsails/jobs/testing that an implementation fails, plus the shipped jsails work wiring and the two-process memory-adapter split. Entries on legacy-*.test.ts record defects of the old jsails/jobs runtime, run through the legacy driver: their fixedBy is JOB-08, which deletes the legacy driver and these test files, and their reason names the package whose new runtime passes the scenario. The same scenarios, less the virtual-time schedules group, fail on the BullMQ adapter against a live Valkey: legacy-valkey.test.ts runs only with JSAILS_TEST_VALKEY=1 and VALKEY_URL, so its entries are scoped to runs that declare the valkey service (the jobs stage of verify:integrations). legacy-memory-explicit-overlap.test.ts runs the overlap scenarios with overlap registered by hand after the chain middleware, where the runtime installs no automatic overlap. packages/jobs/test/memory/conformance.test.ts runs the same scenarios on the new @jsails/jobs code end to end (defineJob, the producer, the envelope, memoryJobs and the worker runtime, JOB-03); it passes every scenario since JOB-04 (flows, failed-job operations, overlap leases and schedules); nothing on it is listed.

test: a key still deduplicates after the first job was evicted

failure.message: ran again after the first job completed and was evicted
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: A key is a jobId, and both adapters free a jobId once the job completes (the memory adapter at once, BullMQ at retention eviction), so the key has no window. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-02).

test: a retried attempt sees the stored payload, not the previous attempt mutation

failure.message: each attempt should start from the stored payload; the handler counted \[2,2\]
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The memory adapter hands every attempt the same payload object it was given at dispatch, so a handler that mutates its payload changes what the retry sees; a serializing transport stores a copy. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-02).

test: an in-flight handler can dispatch while its worker drains

failure.message: an in-flight handler could not dispatch while its worker drained
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: close() marks the whole runtime closed before draining, so ctx.dispatch from an in-flight handler throws JobsRuntimeClosedError and the handler fails. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-03).

test: an overlap skip is reported as skipped, not completed

failure.message: an overlap skip was not reported as skipped
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The overlap middleware returns without calling the handler; no event is emitted and the adapter counts the attempt as completed. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: abort is bounded with a middleware that never returns

failure.message: abort did not resolve within 5000 ms with a middleware that never returns
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Only the handler is raced against the abort signal; middleware runs outside the race, and the memory adapter's force close returns the graceful close promise, so shutdown waits for the middleware forever. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-03).

test: a job never runs alongside its own attempt abandoned by abort

failure.message: a job ran alongside its own abandoned attempt \(2 runs in flight\)
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: An aborted attempt is requeued as soon as the race rejects while its handler keeps running, so the next worker runs the job concurrently with it (no grace or poisoned-worker rule). The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-03).

test: a batch with an invalid item enqueues nothing

failure.message: a batch with an invalid item enqueued 3 of its items
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: createJobBatch registers the batch and dispatches items concurrently; payloads are validated per dispatch, so valid items are enqueued before the invalid one throws, and the batch can never settle. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: a redelivered chain step does not enqueue the next step twice

failure.message: redelivering chain step 1 ran step 2 2 times
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: chainMiddleware dispatches the next step with no key after every successful run, so a redelivered step forks the chain. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: batch callbacks fire after the producer restarts

failure.message: batch callbacks after a producer restart fired \{"then":0,"catch":0,"finally":0\}
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Batch callbacks are closures held in the registering process (SharedBatchCoordinator keeps only progress in the store), so they are lost when that process restarts. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: batch status counts children and reports settlement

failure.message: the implementation reports no batch status
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The legacy batch API has no status read; progress lives in coordinator-private keys. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: retrying a failed chain step continues the chain

failure.message: retrying a failed chain step did not continue the chain \(0 runs of the next step\)
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: queue:retry replays only allowlisted options and drops the chain descriptor, so a retried step cannot rejoin its chain. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: a 30-day interval fires once in its first 30 days

failure.message: cannot hold a schedule interval longer than 2147483647 ms
failure.name: JobsRuntimeError

entries.reason: The memory adapter refuses an interval above the Node timer limit (the M0 guard against the 1 ms clamp) instead of holding it with a long timer. setLongInterval exists since JOB-02; the memory adapter's schedule ticker holds it with setLongTimeout (JOB-04). The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: a job unknown to a worker is released, then run by a worker that knows it

failure.message: a job unknown to the first worker was not left for a worker that knows it
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: An unknown job name fails terminally (JobNotRegisteredError marked non-retryable) instead of being released, so a worker of an older release burns jobs of a newer one. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-03).

test: a child retried after its batch settled does not fire the callbacks again

failure.message: the implementation reports no batch status
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The legacy runtime keeps batch state only in the producer's SharedBatchCoordinator and exposes no batch status, so a retry after settlement cannot be counted or kept from the callbacks. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: a failed chain step whose catch fired is refused without force and retried with it

failure.message: the legacy runtime has no chain catch
failure.name: Error

entries.reason: createJobChain takes steps only: there is no chain catch to fire once or to guard a retry with, so the legacy driver refuses the scenario. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: a resumed schedule skips the fire times it missed while paused

failure.message: a resumed schedule fired 0 times at its next slot
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The legacy runtime has no resume: pauseSchedules records the id in the pause store, and upsertSchedules, its documented way to resume, skips every id the pause store holds, so a paused schedule never fires again. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: a cron schedule fires on its occurrences, not at reconcile

failure.message: the memory adapter supports interval schedules only
failure.name: JobsRuntimeError

entries.reason: The legacy memory adapter refuses cron schedules (only BullMQ evaluates cron patterns), so a process-reach transport cannot run one. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: an overlap skip is reported as skipped, not completed

failure.message: an overlap skip was not reported as skipped
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: With overlap registered by hand the middleware still returns without calling the handler; no event is emitted and the adapter counts the attempt as completed. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: an overlap skip does not advance a chain

failure.message: an overlap-skipped chain step advanced the chain
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: With the documented per-job stack [chainMiddleware, batch, createOverlapMiddleware(leases)] the runtime adds no automatic overlap, so overlap runs inside chainMiddleware; it skips without running the handler, next() resolves, and chainMiddleware dispatches the next step. The new runtime passes this scenario on memory/conformance.test.ts (JOB-04).

test: a key still deduplicates after the first job was evicted

failure.message: ran again after the first job completed and was evicted
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: A key is a jobId, and BullMQ frees a jobId once the completed job is evicted (removeOnComplete), so the key has no window. The new memory driver holds the window (JOB-02); the Valkey transport maps keys to a deduplication ttl in JOB-05. The new runtime is to pass this scenario on the Valkey adapter's conformance run with JOB-05.

failure.message: neither run nor refused
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The memory adapter is process-local and declares no reach, so splitting producer and worker over it silently loses jobs instead of being refused with adapter_not_shared.

test: a chain advances on a worker started by jsails work

failure.message: jsails work ran \["first"\] of a two-step chain
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: jobsPlugin's jobs.worker unit builds its runtime with no middleware and the plugin has no option for it, so chainMiddleware never runs under jsails work; only a hand-built runtime can chain. The test is deleted with the old jobs plugin in JOB-08.

test: a batch settles on a worker started by jsails work

failure.message: a batch on a jsails work worker settled 0 times
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: jsails work (jobsPlugin's jobs.worker unit) registers no batch middleware, so batch children never record progress and callbacks never fire. The test is deleted with the old jobs plugin in JOB-08.
